name: Supply Request
description: Hello, young man. Prapor has told me about your situation. You're in a bit of trouble, yes? Well, I am willing to help you. I'll provide you with medicine, emergency routes, and other forms of aid.. but I have to see if you can be trusted with my work. Recently, we have been running quite low on medical supplies... Tarkov has been overrun with the sick and injured. I would like you to deliver some supplies to us, just to get the clinic back on its feet. It's nothing too extraordinary, just a few AI-2 medical kits and one of those Salewa emergency first aid kits. Maybe we can start discussing true work after this.

_props.description: Hand over Salewa First Aid Kit
